title: Finite-energy weak solutions and relaxation for a compressible kinetic--fluid system with locally averaged Brinkman force
summary: We study a kinetic--fluid system in which a Vlasov or Vlasov--Fokker--Planck equation is coupled to the compressible Navier--Stokes equations with density-dependent viscosities through a locally averaged Brinkman force. The averaging is chosen in a conservative form so that the coupled system preserves the total momentum and satisfies a natural energy-dissipation balance, while avoiding the pointwise evaluation of a possibly rough fluid velocity.
